title: BTS FESTA 2026: Jimin & Jungkook Release 'We Don't Talk Anymore Pt. 2' Collaborative Track
detail: June 3, 2026 — Day 3 of BTS FESTA 2026: Jimin (Park Ji-min) and Jungkook (Jeon Jung-kook) release 'We Don't Talk Anymore Pt. 2,' a collaborative FESTA track dropping as part of the official 13th anniversary countdown content schedule on Weverse and YouTube. The release is a spiritual successor to their beloved 2017 FESTA cover of Charlie Puth ft. Selena Gomez's 'We Don't Talk Anymore,' which became one of the most celebrated non-album BTS recordings. The 2026 iteration is an original composition — not a cover — leaning into an R&B-pop sonic space, featuring layered harmonies between Jimin's silk falsetto and Jungkook's golden tenor. In the 2026 FESTA context, the track carries particular emotional resonance: it is the first new collaborative sub-unit recording from any BTS pair since the group reunited after completing military service. ARMY streaming coordination pushes the track to trend globally across Spotify, Melon, Bugs, and X (Twitter) within hours of release. The release reinforces the broader BTS FESTA 2026 narrative — seven members back together, actively creating and performing, with 9 days remaining until the Busan Asiad Main Stadium anniversary concerts on June 12–13.
